---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new skill, agent, domain, or tool improvement
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What Would You Like?

A clear description of the feature or addition.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New skill card (`skills/<name>.md`)
- [ ] New agent (`agents/<name>.md`)
- [ ] New domain (`config/domain_profiles.yaml` entry)
- [ ] Improvement to an existing tool (`tools/` or `context_loaders/`)
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Other

## Domain This Serves

Which domain(s) would benefit most?
`software` / `content` / `research` / `data_analytics` / `product_design` / `marketing` / `ops_process` / `general`

## Example Task

What task would a user be trying to accomplish that this feature enables?

```
## Task
[domain: X] <example task description>
```

## Expected Output / Behavior

What should the AI produce or do differently with this feature?

## Why Not Use an Existing Skill?

What gap does this fill that `compare_approaches`, `review_code`, etc. don't cover?

## Additional Context

Links, examples, prior art, or anything else useful.
